narrative.overview:
This is a scoped record of the implemented `/student` workspace and the related sign-in, registration, email confirmation and password recovery screens. It extends the current UET identity; it does not replace the root design system or prescribe changes to practice, the board engine or tournament operations.

The workspace is a quiet administrative surface for Vietnamese students. A navy rail carries navigation, while cool light content uses headings, numbered steps and divided data rows to make the next action visible. Account entry screens carry the same identity through a navy introduction beside a focused form.

The unmodified university icon is served from `public/brand/uet.ico`, with provenance in `public/brand/SOURCE.md`. Its use accompanies the course-project identity; it does not establish official university service status or VNU SSO.
keyCharacteristics: University blue actions, navy navigation and cool light surfaces.
Vietnamese interface text in Be Vietnam Pro, with locally served font files.
Flat sections and real data rows, with text accompanying state.
Direct verification, private invitation and submission actions.

rules.name: The Action and State Rule
rules.body: Keep blue for actions and navigation; keep success and error colors attached to explicit feedback text.

rules.name: The Local Overflow Rule
rules.body: Keep wide membership and account rows scrollable within their table container while the surrounding page remains fluid.

rules.name: The Divided Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate related account, team and event content with spacing and thin rules; preserve the flat page structure.

dos: Do preserve blue actions, navy navigation and flat divided sections in this scoped surface.
Do keep account, verification and membership status readable as text.
Do retain local font loading for standalone account screens and the student page.
Do show the next action supported by actual verification, membership and tournament state.
Do preserve the local Mailpit notice when that demo mode is active.
Do retain the sourced icon and its documented course-project context.
donts: Don't add decorative shadows or gradients to this flat student workspace.
Don't turn team and account rows into nested dashboard cards.
Don't expose organizer controls as student actions or imply the frontend grants organizer rights.
Don't represent local Mailpit delivery as external email delivery or VNU SSO.
Don't replace the sourced university icon with a fabricated university seal.
